text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(—I always used to think about it. About 
the day my ingredients would shine the 
brightest.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(It will surely be truly wonderful. A 
haute couture made just for me...—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—Not yet!! I'm the absolute! 
Faaaaasteeeest!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No! This brilliance... I will never—hand 
it over!!

text_block_list.name: Flight & Bakushin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah......!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Shining in my own way. My heart is 
fluttering—how wonderful!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
North Flight! It's North Flight!! 
Defeating her rival, Sakura Bakushin O! 
The winner is—North Flight!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Following up on the Yasuda Kinen, another 
Mile G1 victory! She becomes only the 4th 
Umamusume in history to conquer the Spring 
and Autumn Mile double!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Without a shadow of a doubt! A new "Queen 
of the Mile" is born...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Just like when I put on new clothes. Just 
like when I try out a new outfit.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(It's so bright, so thrilling... I'm so 
happy, and my heart won't stop pounding.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
This is my... the absolute peak brilliance 
that only I could ever wear.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(I dreamed. I believed. I worked hard. I 
found it. I decided—this is who I am.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yeah! This is... who I am!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes...! I think so too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Guuuuh! Amazing! Flight-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, heroes never stay down! Bakushin 
O-senpai is no exception...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All right! I'll get even stronger and—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm? What a sharp gaze!

text_block_list.name: Mile-Loving Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I want to be... just like 
Flight-san—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, what a look in your eyes! I gotta 
make sure I'm a worthy wall to overcome!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...As a hero, just like Flight-senpai and 
the others!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flight-san, congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...I lost. Total defeat!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
“—Therefore! In next year's Mile CS too! I 
will have my revenge!!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I want to see it for myself even more! Me, 
becoming more and more exemplary!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're getting faster and faster!! If we 
just keep racing through the here and 
nowâ

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Before we even knew it, we were already 
past the Bakushin line!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep pushing speed to its absolute 
limit! As long as I have you—and you have 
me!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "We can keep shining..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Bakushin O-chan. Let's run. Let's 
compete...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Raw talent to be proud of, and rivals to 
polish it against.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(And—with you by my side, always 
validating who I am, I can fly anywhere.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—More, more! Because I want to love the 
"me" I was born to be!
